texts: One animation library, any humanoid skeleton: how three.ws retargets motion

Our animation clips were made once, on one reference skeleton, and they play on Mixamo, VRoid, Unreal and Daz avatars built later by other tools. The write-up covers how bone names are matched, why a matching name is not enough, and where the retargeter stops on purpose: three.ws/avatar-artifact

altText: A generated 3D circus ringmaster in a red tailcoat, top hat and tall boots standing at rest with his hands open in front of him, lit in red and violet on a dark stage under a starfield. He is idling on the shared animation library in the three.ws Avatar Artifact viewer.

editor.summary: Every claim in the post is verified against the live rig-doctor page and the retargeter source, and the voice contract is fully obeyed. The only note is that the cover shows one avatar rather than the four-rig comparison, which is acceptable for a cover and accurately described by the alt text. Ship it.
